chunks: And ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd narrated from Muḥammad ibn Qays, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The Commander of the Faithful عليه السلام ruled concerning a man and a woman upon whom a house collapsed and killed them, and it was not known which of them died before the other.
So he said: Each one of them is made to inherit from his or her spouse according to what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has prescribed for their heirs.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَا: Amir al-Mu'minin, Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has prescribed
key_terms.يُوَرَّثُ: is made to inherit; inheritance is assigned

ai.seo_question: How is inheritance determined when a husband and wife die together and it is unknown who died first?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a husband and wife who die in a common disaster when it is unknown which one died first. Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام ruled that each is treated as inheriting from the other spouse according to Allah’s prescribed shares, making it a jurisprudential narration on inheritance in cases of uncertain sequence of death.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5658 - Asim ibn Humeid narrated from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:
"The Commander of the Faithful (as) ruled regarding a man and a woman upon whom a house collapsed, causing their death, and it was not known which of them died first.
Imam (as) said: 'Each of them inherits from their spouse according to what Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, has prescribed for their heirs.'"
